theorem lg_target {a b : ℤ} : a.natAbs = b.natAbs ↔ a * a = b * b := by
  split
  · intro h
    rw [Int.natAbs_abs]
    rw [Int.natAbs_abs at h]
    rw [h]
  · intro h
    rw [Int.natAbs_abs]
    rw [Int.natAbs_abs at h]
    apply Int.associated_iff_natAbs
    exact Int.natAbs_eq_iff_associated.symm
